howto.name: Upload an MP4
howto.text: Drop an .mp4 file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: The video is re-encoded as H.264 (CRF 23) and the audio as AAC, even when the MP4 already holds H.264.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. MOV is what QuickTime, Final Cut Pro and much of the macOS video world prefer.

faq.a: MOV is Apple's QuickTime container, preferred by Final Cut Pro, iMovie, and some macOS/iOS workflows. This tool re-encodes the video rather than rewrapping it, even when the codecs would fit.
A little. Every file is re-encoded as H.264 at CRF 23 with AAC audio, so the MOV is not a bit-for-bit copy of the MP4's streams.
No — temporary input/output, deleted after the download.
